title: Bryan Adams
notes: Early radio-rock experiments mix melodic power pop, piano balladry and rough-edged vocals.

title: You Want It You Got It
notes: Harder guitar riffs and polished driving rock frame romantic ballads and brief new-wave colour.

title: Cuts Like a Knife
scene: Canadian / North American 1980s radio and heartland rock
notes: Forceful guitar hooks, expansive choruses and exposed love songs establish a durable mainstream-rock vocabulary.

title: Reckless
scene: 1980s North American arena and radio rock
notes: Big guitar anthems and romantic ballads meet crisp rhythm sections and meticulous analogue recording.

title: Into the Fire
scene: Canadian / North American late-1980s heartland and mainstream rock
notes: Ringing guitars and firm backbeats carry unusually serious historical and political narratives.

title: Waking Up the Neighbours
scene: Early-1990s Canadian mainstream and arena-oriented rock
notes: Meticulous digital production joins outsized rock choruses, tender ballads and harmonised hooks.

title: 18 til I Die
scene: Mid-1990s North American and UK mainstream pop rock
notes: Cheeky guitar rock meets romantic power ballads and one flamenco-coloured crossover song.

title: On a Day Like Today
scene: Late-1990s Canadian melodic pop-rock and adult alternative
sounds_like: Bon Jovi|Goo Goo Dolls|Richard Marx|Matchbox Twenty
notes: Warmer pop-rock arrangements add keyboard colour, orchestral strings and a contrasting female duet.
